mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 255.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten monetary policy which reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% and UNRATE declines by more than 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates weakening consumer demand and potential recession, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior month signals robust manufacturing output and corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO rises by at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 3.0% indicates aggressive monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal expanding consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both rise by the specified thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In labor market slack (unemployment rate below 4.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals tightening labor conditions that may trigger inflationary pressures and monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during labor market slack when UNRATE declines.
